title: Browser local-first public witness
description: A deliberately small React todo surface whose real-Chrome acceptance proves no-declaration public-exact IndexedDB retention, opaque-query refusal, and queued replay.

backend.stalenessPolicy: regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

browser-public-witness.toolchain: node>=24, Vite, a qualified Snapback runtime, and system Chrome

browser-public-witness: current authoritative public rows persist in the default IndexedDB carrier
a full Chrome SIGKILL and same-profile relaunch renders pre-intent retained rows while authority is unreachable
offline add/toggle intents survive process death and replay only after a fresh authoritative snapshot
settlement follows durable sequence order and duplicate delivery republishes without re-execution
a storeless independent Node observer converges to the browser rows and version
under dev custody an opaque public browser query truthfully reports SNAPBACK_RETENTION_NOT_RQS_ELIGIBLE and leaves no IndexedDB entry
a same-process SPA reload reconstructs the React surface without a render storm

on the same browser and origin, an anonymous sessions-mode server rotates owner generation, makes the opaque query report SNAPBACK_RETENTION_NOT_RETAINABLE, and retains the no-declaration public-exact query

notClaiming: Parity claim or local mutation execution
